title: Transition coherence for evaluation mates
statement:
For a left extension F:X→Y with right adjoint U, two evaluation isomorphisms νa:F⋅Vm≅Ga⋅Lp and νb:F⋅Vn≅Gb⋅Lq, scalar adjunctions Lp⊣Rp, Lq⊣Rq, Lh⊣Rh, Lk⊣Rk, Lt⊣Rt, and restriction comparators δ1:Rh⋅Rq≅Rt, δ2:Rp⋅Rk≅Rt, suppose νa and νb transpose to the extension unit followed by the corresponding evaluation-transition right squares. Assume those right squares compose compatibly with the transition τk:Gb→Ga⋅Rk and τh:Vn→Vm⋅Rh. Then the adjunct of τh(FN) equals Lh(νb), the first canonical scalar associator, the inverse second associator, Lp of the adjunct of τk(N), and νa inverse, in that order. The complete right-square equality and all functor types are the hypotheses of the attached Lean declaration.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
variable {X Y A B C D : Type*}
  [Category X] [Category Y] [Category A] [Category B] [Category C] [Category D]
  {F : X ⥤ Y} {U : Y ⥤ X}
  {Ga : X ⥤ A} {Gb : X ⥤ B}
  {Va : Y ⥤ A} {Vb : Y ⥤ B} {Vm : Y ⥤ C} {Vn : Y ⥤ D}
  {Lp : A ⥤ C} {Rp : C ⥤ A} {Lq : B ⥤ D} {Rq : D ⥤ B}
  {Lh : D ⥤ C} {Rh : C ⥤ D} {Lk : B ⥤ A} {Rk : A ⥤ B}
  {Lt : B ⥤ C} {Rt : C ⥤ B}
theorem adjunctionTransition_coherence
    (a : F ⊣ U) (ap : Lp ⊣ Rp) (aq : Lq ⊣ Rq) (ah : Lh ⊣ Rh)
    (ak : Lk ⊣ Rk) (ac : Lt ⊣ Rt)
    (δ₁ : Rh ⋙ Rq ≅ Rt) (δ₂ : Rp ⋙ Rk ≅ Rt)
    (γa : U ⋙ Ga ⟶ Va) (γb : U ⋙ Gb ⟶ Vb)
    (τk : Gb ⟶ Ga ⋙ Rk) (τh : Vn ⟶ Vm ⋙ Rh)
    (τp : Va ⟶ Vm ⋙ Rp) (τq : Vb ⟶ Vn ⋙ Rq)
    (νa : F ⋙ Vm ≅ Ga ⋙ Lp) (νb : F ⋙ Vn ≅ Gb ⋙ Lq)
    (hνa : ∀ N, ap.homEquiv _ _ (νa.inv.app N) =
      Ga.map (a.unit.app N) ≫ γa.app (F.obj N) ≫ τp.app (F.obj N))
    (hνb : ∀ N, aq.homEquiv _ _ (νb.inv.app N) =
      Gb.map (a.unit.app N) ≫ γb.app (F.obj N) ≫ τq.app (F.obj N))
    (hright : ∀ M, γb.app M ≫ τq.app M ≫ Rq.map (τh.app M) ≫ δ₁.hom.app (Vm.obj M) =
      τk.app (U.obj M) ≫ Rk.map (γa.app M) ≫ Rk.map (τp.app M) ≫
        δ₂.hom.app (Vm.obj M)) (N : X) :
    (ah.homEquiv _ _).symm (τh.app (F.obj N)) =
      Lh.map (νb.hom.app N) ≫
      (((aq.comp ah).ofNatIsoRight δ₁).leftAdjointUniq ac).hom.app (Gb.obj N) ≫
      (((ak.comp ap).ofNatIsoRight δ₂).leftAdjointUniq ac).inv.app (Gb.obj N) ≫
      Lp.map ((ak.homEquiv _ _).symm (τk.app N)) ≫ νa.inv.app N
```

proof.text: Precompose with the inverse upper evaluation and inverse first associator, and transpose through Lt⊣Rt. Each inverse associator becomes its right restriction compositor by adjoint uniqueness. Apply the two normalized evaluation equations. The right-square composition law and naturality of τk with respect to the extension unit make both transposes equal. Cancel the two invertible precomposing maps.
